en: Distinctions Concerning Mind Mixed with Discourse (Suttanta)
For whom a mind accompanied by lust arises and does not cease, will that mind accompanied by lust cease and not arise for them?

At the moment of arising of the final mind accompanied by lust, for those individuals, a mind accompanied by lust arises and does not cease; it will cease and will not arise. For others, at the moment of arising of a mind accompanied by lust, for those individuals … [and so on].
